blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — Basilan State College has reached a historic milestone, having been elevated to university status. It was formally declared the Basilan State University (BasSU) during a ceremony held at the institution’s gymnasium in Barangay Sumagdang, Isabela City, Basilan, on Friday. Dr. Shirley Agrupis, Commission on Higher Education (Ched) chairperson, announced the conversion during the ceremony, which was attended by university officials, local leaders, and students. The transition was confirmed through Ched Commission en Banc (CEB) Resolution No. 553-2026, dated Aug. 17, which affirmed that the institution had fully complied with all statutory requirements for university status […]...
